## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6c8e71e058bdff5d36b18d6554b2bca8567961b2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md + none
Security-touching: no

Review of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #34416 (Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#4749, carrying objectstack-ai/cloud#3779). Inputs: both cards with every comment, the PR body, file list and net diff against `main`, and the 48 check-runs on the head. Read to judge, not reviewed: `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `check-skill-id-lint.mjs`, `check-governed-prose.mjs`, and `references/execution-duties.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md` and the sibling lane charters on `main`.

### ① Derived judgments

- File list: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md` only, 4 lines added and 4 removed. Right.
- Line ratchet: the file is 28 lines at the head against the `CEILINGS` row of 28 on `main`; the diff does not touch `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, so no ceiling moved and no cross-file move is declared. This is the zero-net-growth route the Go comment on the card put first. Right.
- Line cap: the longest line at the head is 118 bytes (lines 3, 21, 22 and the new line 26), under the 120-byte cap. Right.
- The `## 范围` heading, its blank lines and its one bullet (3 lines net) became one bullet under `## 形态` with the same text behind a `范围:` prefix. No standing rule was cut. No script under `scripts/pm/` reads a lane's `## 范围` heading; the one prose pointer to a 范围 section (`triage-duties.md` line 11) names `lanes/devx.md`. Right.
- No issue id in the new lines, as the Go comment ordered. Right.
- Check-runs: the gate families that read this file are green on the head (`Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset`). The skipped runs are opt-in jobs, queue-only verdicts, the schedule gate, and build and test shards the path filter leaves out for a docs-only diff: expected, none red.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `.claude/**` ships in no package. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no`, and the diff agrees.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev report's one flag, `line_ratchet_route`, says zero net growth with the ceiling unchanged and no standing rule cut. Verified in ①.
- No `open_questions`.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code.

### ④ Design judgment

`lanes/cloud.md` against card #4749 item 2 (the seat-side form of the rule, in the order and Go text the seats hand card threads, plus the #3779 rule) and against the skill on `main`. The content of the three lines matches the four card rules and the cloud `AGENTS.md` wording of PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4754. Two findings on how they sit in the skill:

- S1 (should-fix) — the lead-in 「CI 分钟(维护者令,入派发令与 Go 词):」 is on line 26 only, and lines 27 and 28 are sibling bullets. Rendered as a list, the instruction to put the rule into the order and Go text binds the first bullet alone, yet the card's item 2 exists for exactly that instruction, and line 27 (one push after ready, no merge of `main`) describes what a card thread does and reaches the thread only through the order. Line 26 also ends without 「。」, unlike every other bullet in the file, which leaves a reader to guess whether the next bullets continue it. Fix: say on line 26 that all three lines go into the order and Go text, and close it. One spelling that fits: 「- CI 分钟三条入派发令与 Go 词(维护者令):`pr_ready` 前容器跑类型检查与受影响测试,入报告。」 (120 bytes).
- S2 (should-fix) — the second half of line 27 restates a rule the skill already states, with a different list. `execution-duties.md` lines 36-38 (并行纪律) say: merge `main` once before opening the PR and once after a sibling lands, otherwise 「⛔ 不追 main … 只冲突/main 致红/踢出队列才合」, and 「派发令与复读请求 ⛔ 不令主动合」; `dispatch-runbook.md` line 226 repeats the three reasons. The new line says 「只冲突拒入队列或席位点名理由才合」. A cloud seat reads both. They differ on a sibling landing (ordered there, forbidden here unless the seat names it), on main-caused red and a dequeue (allowed there, not listed here), and on whether an order may tell a thread to merge at all (refused there, the named exception here). The cloud list is the right one for the cloud repo, where the PR run already tests the merge commit; the line does not say that it replaces the general discipline for this lane. Fix: say which governs, or point at cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7 in place of restating the list, for example 「合 main 照 cloud `AGENTS.md` 第 7 条,先于 `execution-duties.md` 并行纪律」.
- N1 (nit) — line 26 says 「结果入报告」; the card and cloud `AGENTS.md` say the command and the result. A thread reads `AGENTS.md`, so nothing is lost in practice.
- N2 (nit) — 「Go 词」 is new to the skill, which says 派发令 and 派发词 everywhere else and defines no Go text. The card uses the term and cloud seats post a Go comment, so it is understood on this lane.
- N3 (nit) — the 范围 bullet now sits under `## 形态`, and six sibling lane charters keep a `## 范围` heading. It is the price of the zero-net-growth route the seat ordered; nothing reads the heading.

No must-fix. S1 and S2 are open on this head and earn a delta review of their fix.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `98b349f3690bf5fd7bc1457d9d7d711a7291a441`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md + none
Security-touching: no

Delta review of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #34416 (Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#4749), after the record on head `6c8e71e0`. Inputs: the delta between the two heads (3 lines of `lanes/cloud.md`), the net diff against `main`, the PR body, the check-runs on this head, and the files the new text cites, read on `main`: cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7, `execution-duties.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`. Everything the earlier record judged outside these three lines is unchanged and stands.

### ① Derived judgments

- File list: still `lanes/cloud.md` only; net 4 lines added and 4 removed against `main`. The delta rewrites lines 26-28 and nothing else. Right.
- Line ratchet: 28 lines at this head against the ceiling of 28; the ratchet script is not in the diff. Right.
- Line cap: lines 26, 27 and 28 are 118, 119 and 115 bytes, under the 120-byte cap. Right.
- Form: the three rules are now one bullet with two continuation lines indented two spaces under the marker's content column. That is the form the ratchet's own wrapper produces (its self-test rows `a list continuation is indented under the marker` and `no continuation line opens a new markdown block`), and the corpus already carries it (`contract-review.md` lines 35-38 on `main`). Neither continuation line opens with a list, quote, heading or table marker (「与」 and 「③」). The break after line 26 falls between two Han characters, so it renders with no space; the break after line 27 follows an ASCII `;` after an ASCII `)`, which is not the leaked junction the ratchet refuses and renders as an ordinary space at a clause boundary. Right.
- No issue id in the new text. Right.
- Check-runs on this head, read twice: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size` and `filter` are green; the lint and type-check families, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` among them, were still in progress at the time of writing, none red. The skipped runs are opt-in, queue-only or path-filtered jobs. The line count and byte widths above are read from the tree; the gate verdict on this head is the check-runs' to give, and the seat reads them complete before it adopts this record.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset` is right, nothing ships. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body agrees with the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No new dev flag and no `open_questions` on the card thread for this push.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code.

### ④ Design judgment

S1: closed
S2: closed

- On the first: the lead-in now reads 「CI 分钟三条入派发令与 Go 词(维护者令):」 and the three rules follow as ①②③ inside the same bullet, so the instruction binds all three; the bullet ends with 「。」.
- On the second: the restated exception list is gone. The line now says 「合 main 照 cloud `AGENTS.md` 第 7 条(先于通用纪律)」: one source for the cloud rule, and a statement that it governs over the general discipline. Cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7 on `main` already carries the rule this points at (a PR behind `main` needs no action; merge only on a conflict that keeps it out of the queue), and objectstack-ai/cloud#4754 tightens the same sentence, so the pointer is right before and after that PR lands and does not depend on landing order.
- The earlier nit on line 26 is fixed as well: it now says 「命令与结果入报告」.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — 「通用纪律」 names no file. A reader has to know it means the 并行纪律 lines of `execution-duties.md` (36-38) and `dispatch-runbook.md` line 226. There is no byte room on line 27 (119 of 120) to name them.
- N2 (nit) — the PR body still describes the earlier wording: its What-changes list says the result goes in the report and spells the merge rule as its own exception list, where the tree now says command and result and defers to cloud `AGENTS.md` rule 7; 速读 item 3 likewise. The body is not the contract and editing it moves no head; the thread should bring it in line before the maintainer reads it.
- The two nits left open by the earlier record (「Go 词」 new to the skill; the 范围 bullet under `## 形态`) are unchanged and stay nits.
